caption: A rain-soaked night market street in Taipei, photographed at eye level in 35mm style. Warm tungsten bulbs hang above crowded food stalls, reflecting in shallow puddles on the asphalt. A vendor in a navy apron turns a cast-iron wok; steam drifts toward the right side of the frame. Several blurred customers hold clear umbrellas. The color palette is amber, teal, and deep brown, with strong contrast between the lit stalls and the dark street. Shallow depth of field, slight film grain, documentary photography.

caption.long: A square editorial poster with a muted sage-green background and a thin cream border. In the upper left, a small white sans-serif label reads "FIELD NOTES". The center contains a high-contrast black-and-white photograph of a fern frond, cropped so the tip exits the top edge. Below the image, two lines of small dark-green serif text read "VOLUME 04" and "SPRING 2026", separated by a short horizontal rule. Generous negative space, flat lighting, Swiss editorial layout.
caption.medium: A square sage-green editorial poster with a cream border, a black-and-white fern photograph in the center, and the labels FIELD NOTES, VOLUME 04, and SPRING 2026 in small type.
caption.short: A minimalist sage-green editorial poster featuring a fern photograph and small serif labels.
